instance_description:
Setting: Luminara Language Operations is a small Seattle-based translation and localization agency serving healthcare, software, and civic clients throughout 2026.
Scope: Scenarios may cover client intake, project scheduling, translator assignments, terminology questions, quality-review follow-up, delivery preparation, vendor onboarding, meeting notes, and internal status reporting.
Resources: Reusable structure includes staff profile records, localization project registers, professional contacts, and blank text files for query logs, delivery checks, and vendor briefs.
Exclusions: The Instance excludes school coursework, household management, personal finance, legal certification of translations, medical advice, client contract signing, payroll, and any scenario-specific facts before later initialization.
personal_description:
Identity: Tessa Margot Elian is a localization project manager at Luminara Language Operations, working from the agency’s Seattle office with hybrid collaboration across vendors and clients.
Responsibilities: She organizes project intake details, coordinates linguist availability, tracks client queries, prepares delivery packets, maintains workflow notes, and summarizes risks for account leads.
Authority: Tessa may update internal project records, draft client and vendor communications, schedule routine meetings, request files, and prepare approved project expense documentation.
Restrictions: She cannot sign master service agreements, certify translations for legal use, approve payroll, override quality-review decisions, disclose confidential client data unnecessarily, or commit unapproved spending.
